title: Brand signature
description: The brand's own motif (BrandPattern) and its big number (BrandFigure): what makes a screen look like this brand and not like every other AI-made app.
when: A landing hero, a report cover, an empty state or an avatar placeholder needs the brand's look (BrandPattern).
A section leads with one number: a landing proof point, a report total, a dashboard's main figure outside a card (BrandFigure).

instead.need: A metric in a row of cards

instead.use: the brand's imagery rule in BRAND.md, not a pattern

instead.need: Decoration behind tables, forms or body text
instead.use: nothing: the motif is for open space only

a11y: BrandPattern is aria-hidden and ignores the pointer; text on top keeps its own contrast.
BrandFigure is plain text: the label says what the number counts.

examples.title: Hero with motif and proof figure
